tools.name: search_public_hooks
tools.description: Use for any question about open trips or day outs to join: by city slug, month (YYYY-MM), kind (trip or dayout), budget tier or mood. Each hook carries its public TripHook page (url) and, for a day out, the What's on page (event_page). The reply ends with links: show them as one short line, for exam

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Use to find which cities have open group trips and day outs, with counts of trips and day outs, each city's slug (for the other tools) and its TripHook city page (url). The reply ends with links: show them as one short line, for example "Search on TripHook". For any where should I go, where is warm

tools.name: events_and_company
tools.description: Use for any question about what is happening in a city on a date (city slug, date YYYY-MM-DD) and whether other travellers are going: each listed event with its ticket link (url), the TripHook What's on page for that day (whats_on), how many open public day outs are going and their links (company).

tools.name: search_destinations
tools.description: Use for any question like "where should I go" with a budget, a temperature, a mood, dates or a month: the same TripHook Discover search a signed out visitor gets, ranked from Vienna or the given departure city. Give dates { depart, ret } or a month (1 to 12); where, from, temp_min, temp_max, budget_
